collect_note: Reads EPRI's own content database (the GraphQL service the epri.com page calls; the public key in the URL is the one in epri.com's JavaScript) twice a day and keeps a page whose title is the university award call only once it has content, so the call page going live shows up as a candidate. The 'University RFP' page exists but is empty today (the website shows Page Not Found), so zero items is expected until EPRI republishes the call.

zero_reason.reason: EPRI's CMS entry 'University RFP' (slug university-rfp) has no content and the 2025 call PDFs (restservice.epri.com/publicattachment/91383, 91384, 94161) return 404; the site is a JavaScript app so no verbatim quote can be fetched with fetch_text.py

evidence: 2026-11-13 channels: (1) epri.com/university-rfp is a React shell (9 chars over HTTP). (2) The site JS (main.3cd53501.chunk.js) calls https://apim.epri.com/partner/graphql/v2 with header Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key (a public key embedded in the bundle); the same key also works as query parameter subscription-key (HTTP 200), which the json_api adapter can send because it has no header option; introspection is disabled. (3) pageCollection returns 147 Contentful pages incl. title 'University RFP' slug university-rfp sys.id 5eYHiC9PcUrf3GmJg38cZ8 with content null (unpublished/empty); all other pages have content. Query arguments (where, limit, skip) are ignored by the gateway so the whole collection is returned each time and the filter picks the page; first 100 items are read, the page is item 12. (4) pressReleaseLanding id 4ZmTDmJFUIOciU0O6oKqOK lists 217 press releases (newest 2026-11-10); the only university award one is 'EPRI Announces Recipients of 2023 University Global Research Awards; Opens 2024 Applications' (2024-02-20): no 2025 or 2026 round was announced there. (5) restservice.epri.com/publicattachment/{91383,91384,94161} (2025 call documents found by web search) return 404; 84836 (older University Research Award template) still 200. (6) sitemap.xml 635 URLs, no university entries; no RSS; web search finds no 2026 call, last known cycle: 2025 call with a 1 June 2025 deadline (secondary sources).
